title: Saudi Arabian Grilled Skewers
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from Saudi Arabia, featuring marinated chicken and vegetables grilled to perfection on skewers.

ingredients.name: Saudi Arabian spices (Baharat)
ingredients.notes: available at Middle Eastern grocery stores

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, and Saudi Arabian spices.
Add chicken, onions, and peppers to the bowl, and mix well to coat.
Thread the marinated chicken and vegetables onto the skewers.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat, and cook skewers for 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley and lemon wedges.
Cook skewers to an internal temperature of at least 165°F (74°C) to ensure food safety.
Let skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
